map.根据总可用时间和各科难度/优先级权重，合理分配每日或每周学习时长。: Allocate daily or weekly study time by total available time and each subject's difficulty / priority weight.
map.📖 查看「学习计划时长分配 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Study Time Allocation User Guide"
map.按权重分配每日学习时长：科目 i 时长 = 总可用时长 × 该科目权重 ÷ 全部: Daily study time is allocated by weight: time for subject i = total available time × that subject's weight ÷ sum of all weights. A higher weight earns more time, so limited time can be concentrated on priority subjects.
map.权重越大表示该科目越难或越优先，分配时间会越多。: A larger weight means the subject is harder or higher priority, so it receives more time.
map.📚 深度解析：按总学习时长与科目权重（或薄弱优先）生成可视化时长分配方案，帮助科: 📚 In-depth: generates a visual time allocation plan from total study time and subject weights (or weak-subject priority), helping you plan revision scientifically.
map.权重分配：按科目权重拆分总时长。: Weighted allocation: split the total time by subject weight.
map.平均分配：各科均摊时间。: Even allocation: share the time equally across subjects.
map.薄弱优先：给弱项更高权重。: Weak-subject priority: give higher weights to weak areas.
Example: with 10 hours total and weights 3 for math, 2 for English and 1 for Chinese, the split is math 5h, English 3.33h and Chinese 1.67h.
map.按掌握度与考试占比自行设定，弱项给高权重。: Set them yourself from mastery level and how much each subject counts in the exam, giving weak subjects higher weights.
map.可动态增删？: Can subjects be added or removed?
map.支持动态添加/删除科目并实时重算。: Yes, subjects can be added or removed dynamically with instant recalculation.
map.本工具仅分配时长，具体任务需另行拆解。: This tool only allocates time; the concrete tasks have to be broken down separately.
map.科学规划学习时间是提高效率的关键。本工具根据总时长和科目权重，帮助您快速生成一份: Planning study time scientifically is key to efficiency. From total time and subject weights, this tool generates a visual allocation plan for you.
